NakoTurk

I'm from Turkey. I've been interested in testnets for a long time. And I participated in many tests. I am the first person to open a channel in the Testnet category on Youtube Turkey. Through this, I have helped many people to enter and learn in this sector. I also continue to be and teach by posting videos, guides. I am the founder and manager of Celestia and Autonomys Network projects Telegram channels in Turkey. Along with the Discord of these two projects, I am also moderating the Discord of the Dymension project and am an Ambassador at Autonomys Network. I took part in mainnet and testnets with both node setups. I joined the test network of 500+ projects and ran 1000+ nodes. In addition to my experience in testnets. I have experience in video editing, community management and moderate visual design. There are also works I have done on Youtube.

I'm running nodes on the Mina, Humanode, Obol Mainnet Beta and DePIN projects mainnets. I also left links to other projects that I have run on node. ⠀

Gno.land’s unique approach to smart contract execution and its commitment to deterministic architecture stand out as a major leap forward in Web3 infrastructure. As node operators, our goal is to reinforce the network’s stability with high-availability infrastructure, while actively empowering the developer community through open-source tooling, monitoring setups, and step-by-step technical guides.

### 🏢 Validator Profile: Chainbase

#### 🌐 Links & Contacts
- **Website:** https://chainbase.com
- **X (Twitter):** https://x.com/ChainbaseHQ
- **Email:** staking@chainbase.com

#### 📊 Networks & AuM
Validating on 20+ major public chains and protocols (including Ethereum, SUI, Walrus, Bouncebit, Flare, Somnia, EigenDA, Bitway, Lava, Avail, Lido, etc.) with a total AuM exceeding $25 Million.

#### 💡 Why interested in gno.land?
Chainbase positions itself not just as a validator service provider, but as a "strong ecosystem collaborator." We are highly optimistic about the growth of emerging networks and aim to achieve long-term win-win cooperation with project teams through early Foundation Delegation and deep co-marketing initiatives.

#### 🛠️ Contributions to gno.land
- **Technical Excellence:** Our team brings 10+ years of DevOps experience and 3+ years of maintaining mainstream nodes (such as Ethereum and Cosmos ecosystems). We commit to a 99.99% uptime, utilizing multi-layer DDoS protection, BGP Anycast traffic distribution, and enterprise-grade key safety management via HSMs, Google Cloud KMS, and multi-signature protocols.
- **Ecosystem Growth:** With a dedicated team of marketing and business operations experts, we are eager to collaborate with gno.land on co-marketing initiatives. We will leverage our influence among institutional clients (such as HashGlobal) and the staking community to drive traffic and attract more delegators to the network.
